title: Pip and the Odd Round Thing
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 2 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell i, o, o, u
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.

pages.text: Pip spots a round thing by the nest.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow discovering a small, shiny round bead lying on the ground near his nest.

pages.text: Pip taps the round thing with his beak.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tapping the round object gently with his beak, curious.

pages.text: It did not crack. It sits still.
pages.illustration: The round bead staying perfectly still and whole after the tap.

pages.text: Pip rolls the round thing bit by bit.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow nudging the bead so it rolls slowly across the ground.

pages.text: Pip sniffs it. It has no smell.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow leaning in close to sniff at the shiny bead.

pages.text: Pip can not tell what it is.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tilting his head, puzzled, looking at the bead.

pages.text: Olive flies past and spots the bead.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying overhead, noticing the shiny bead on the ground below.

pages.text: Olive gasps. "That is a bead from my gift!"
pages.illustration: Olive the owl landing beside Pip, pointing at the bead with recognition.

pages.text: Pip gets the bead back to Olive.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow carefully carrying the bead over to Olive.

pages.text: Olive is glad Pip spots it first.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Pip the sparrow together, the bead held safely between them.
